text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I'll engrave it into your brain!
My race—!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The earth, the earth is bouncing under Mr. C.B.!
Achieving the Classic Triple Crown for the first time in decades!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable...! What a phenomenal race!
She is only the third Triple Crown Umamusume in history!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... ngh, WOOOOAAAHHH!!
I did it, I actually pulled it off!!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator
text_block_list.text:
S-Seriously, a new era is dawning!
Five crowns, no, even six crowns...!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
She can do it! She's gonna surpass the 'Myth'!
Ah, man, I'm following her for the rest of my life!
C.B. is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text: Incredible. ...It's amazing to witness the birth of yet another Triple Crown Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
With this one, surely a new myth would...
No, but at that point in time,
perhaps the existing "Myth" was still stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
――……
Ace, this one's for you……

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: This heat, this speed... I give everything in this race to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The thunderous applause and deafening cheers
refused to quiet down for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume, C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...Though, sorry.
I'm not really all that interested in it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so. But... I was just thinking!
You really are amazing after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"And then, my eyes were finally opened.
...Sorry for everything up till now."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're not a wall, you're an opponent.
A formidable rival who tries to snatch my victory away.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Wanting to surpass you" isn't enough to win. I have
to beat you down completely.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The spark has finally caught fire!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Next time I'll beat you! No, whether you're there
or not, I'm gonna win every single race!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My race...
That's where the rebellious "Ace" begins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace's eyes locked straight onto Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm just so happy.
I'm glad, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to the next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, Katsuragi Ace fearlessly grasps the right hand Mr. C.B. has offered."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Splashed across the front page was "Triple Crown Achieved"—
Yet for Mr. C.B., the Kikuka Sho had granted her a treasure far greater than that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, you.
Have you noticed anything about C.B.'s legs?”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She's playing it off well,
but she's definitely feeling something off right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, taking a reluctant Mr. C.B. to the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It's mild, but you have sprained it.
Please rest for a few days.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aargh, and here I was doing so well playing dumb, until Ace had to go and...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rehab periods are so boring.
They're making a fuss over nothing anyway.
choice_data_list: I'm not exaggerating. Let's make sure it's properly treated.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay. Guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with visible reluctance,
her recuperation period began—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The next race, huh?
Which one should we go for?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"A GⅠ race would be great. It was fun.
A heated one where Ace would probably show up, too..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about this one? The "Takarazuka Kinen"!
Popular girls are strong girls, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I'm hoping for some excitement
as hot as the Classic season!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The recovery period ended without issue,
and the days of training towards her next race,
the Takarazuka Kinen, had begun!
